findings.desc: quality-cleanup: done-merge-experience-refresh-smoke.ts:174 — non-null assertion cache! is unsound (TypeScript cannot infer process.exit(1) as noreturn, so cache remains FindingSignalsCache|null at this point) and the as-number cast that follows is redundant (typeof cache?.coveredFindingCount === 'number' already narrows it). Fix: pull the null guard into a real branch before this line (e.g. if (!cache) { ... return; }), then drop both the non-null assertion and the cast.

quality-cleanup: learning-validate.ts:129+146 — coverage gap comparison is scoped incorrectly when args.story filter is active. deriveFindingSignalsFromStore is called with { storyIds } (single-story subset), so cache.coveredFindingCount/.coveredStoryCount reflect only that one story. But readFindingSignals(cwd) on line 145 reads the FULL persisted cache (all stories). computeCoverageGap then compares partial current counts against a full persisted watermark, producing a confusing/misleading gap line (e.g. persisted=50 findings, derived=3 for one story => gap shows 0 because max(3-50,0)=0 — a false in-sync signal). Fix: skip the coverage gap report (or emit 'coverage: n/a (filtered view)') when storyIds filter is active.
